vocab_test.desc: Take a few minutes to find your vocabulary level

vocab_test.pyramid_desc: Higher levels indicate a broader vocabulary. Your result is at {{label}}.
vocab_test.result_tip: Results are for reference only. Use them to plan lessons and review. Selecting "Don't know" helps get closer to your true level.
vocab_test.cap.0.canDo: Can recognize a few basic words (colors, numbers, greetings), but cannot yet understand complete sentences or short texts.
vocab_test.cap.0.nextStep: Focus on high-frequency beginner words, practice listening and repeating, then move to very short sentences.
vocab_test.cap.1.canDo: Can recognize common simple words, but reading full sentences and understanding short texts is still difficult.
vocab_test.cap.1.nextStep: Consolidate primary-level words, practice word-to-meaning and listening discrimination, then gradually approach simple sentences.
vocab_test.cap.2.canDo: Familiar with everyday basic words, can barely understand very short simple sentences, but continuous reading and understanding full conversations is still unstable.
vocab_test.cap.2.nextStep: Add short sentence reading practice alongside vocabulary, moving from recognizing words to understanding sentences.
vocab_test.cap.3.canDo: Can handle most common primary-level words, short sentence reading is forming, but longer paragraphs or unfamiliar topics still cause difficulty.
vocab_test.cap.3.nextStep: Expand topic vocabulary (school, weather, shopping, etc.) and use spaced repetition to consolidate learned words.
vocab_test.cap.4.canDo: Approaching middle school entry: can read simple narrative sentences, but complex sentences, abstract words, and longer texts are still challenging.
vocab_test.cap.4.nextStep: Strengthen verb phrases and common collocations, practice intensive reading to improve sentence-to-paragraph understanding.
vocab_test.cap.5.canDo: Can read simple short texts fairly smoothly, everyday conversation vocabulary is mostly sufficient, but essays and exam-level long sentences still need support.
vocab_test.cap.5.nextStep: Systematically fill in core middle school vocabulary, and start training paragraph main idea and keyword extraction.
vocab_test.cap.6.canDo: Can handle most content words in regular middle and high school reading, can follow simple explanatory texts; complex arguments and academic words still have gaps.
vocab_test.cap.6.nextStep: Expand by topic (technology, society, environment), and combine with error word spaced repetition.
vocab_test.cap.7.canDo: Approaching high school / CET-4 entry: can grasp the gist of general news articles and classroom materials, but precise reading still needs dictionary support.
vocab_test.cap.7.nextStep: Break through synonyms and polysemous words, accumulate high-frequency writing word chunks.
vocab_test.cap.8.canDo: Can independently read most general English materials, listening and reading barriers in class are significantly reduced; professional/academic texts still pose challenges.
vocab_test.cap.8.nextStep: Push toward CET-6 / IELTS: academic words, collocations, and intensive reading of long complex sentences.
vocab_test.cap.9.canDo: Approaching higher exam level: can read most argumentative and explanatory texts fairly smoothly, expression is more precise.
vocab_test.cap.9.nextStep: Focus on low-frequency words, near-synonym discrimination, and idiomatic writing expression.
vocab_test.cap.10.canDo: Broad vocabulary, few barriers in general academic and professional reading, can support higher-level listening, speaking, reading, and writing tasks.
vocab_test.cap.10.nextStep: Refine by target scenarios (academic, professional, exam) with focused practice.

legal.about.intro: CloudSteps is a product designed for language learning and training. We are committed to providing learners and coaches with a more efficient, trackable, and sustainable learning and training experience. We offer learning-related modules including, but not limited to, training records, review plans, study reminders, personal center, and account settings.

We value user experience and information security, and we continuously improve service stability and availability. If you encounter issues or have suggestions while using the product, please contact us through the in-app feedback channel.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.subtitle: Updated: August 29, 2026
legal.privacy.intro: CloudSteps ("we") understands the importance of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and protect your personal information, and how you may exercise your related rights. Please read carefully before using our services. By using our services, you acknowledge the processing rules described in this policy. Where sensitive personal information or separate consent is required by law, we will obtain your consent separately.
This policy applies to CloudSteps Web, mini programs, and related clients. If a specific feature has a separate privacy notice, that notice takes precedence over this policy where they conflict.
legal.privacy.section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
legal.privacy.section1.intro: To support language learning, coaching, and account security, we may collect the following information:

legal.privacy.section1.items.label: Account information:
legal.privacy.section1.items.body: Email, phone number (if bound), nickname, avatar, role (learner/coach, etc.), and login credentials.

legal.privacy.section1.items.label: Learning and training data:
legal.privacy.section1.items.body: Wordbook selections, memorization/review progress, test results, training session records, spaced-repetition plans, scenario dialogue and scoring-related data.

legal.privacy.section1.items.label: Coaching business data:
legal.privacy.section1.items.body: Student profiles (when you add or link students), lesson quotas, course appointments, and notes (visible only to users with appropriate permissions).

legal.privacy.section1.items.label: Device and log information:
legal.privacy.section1.items.body: Device model, operating system, browser type, IP address, network status, operation logs, and crash information for security, troubleshooting, and experience optimization.

legal.privacy.section1.items.label: Information you provide voluntarily:
legal.privacy.section1.items.body: Feedback content, contact details, custom wordbooks, notes, and other content you submit.

legal.privacy.section1.items.label: Local storage:
legal.privacy.section1.items.body: To improve experience, we may cache wordbook catalogs, preferences, login state, and other necessary information on your device.

legal.privacy.section1.footer: We do not require collection of personal information unrelated to our services. You may refuse to provide non-essential information, but some features may become unavailable.
legal.privacy.section2.title: 2. How We Use Information
legal.privacy.section2.items: Create and maintain accounts, perform identity verification, and ensure login security;
Provide core features including wordbook learning, testing, review, scheduling, and student management;
Generate learning records and progress statistics, and display necessary information to you or authorized coaches;
Perform technology processing related to learning, such as text-to-speech and spoken dialogue;
Send service notifications (e.g., course reminders and important announcements);
Troubleshoot issues, ensure security, and prevent fraud and abuse;
Use anonymized or aggregated data to improve product experience and feature design;
Fulfill obligations required by applicable laws and regulations.
legal.privacy.section3.title: 3. Storage Location, Retention, and Protection
legal.privacy.section3.body: We store your personal information within the People's Republic of China. If cross-border transfer is required for business purposes, we will comply with applicable assessment, notification, and consent requirements.
We retain information only for the minimum period necessary to achieve the purposes described in this policy. After that period, we delete or anonymize data unless otherwise required by law.

We implement reasonable and feasible security measures, including access control, encryption in transit and at rest, permission tiers, auditing, and security monitoring. The internet is not absolutely secure; please safeguard your account credentials. If a security incident occurs, we will notify you and take remedial measures as required by law.
legal.privacy.section4.title: 4. Processing, Sharing, Transfer, and Disclosure
legal.privacy.section4.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may entrust processing, share, transfer, or publicly disclose information only in the following circumstances:
legal.privacy.section4.items: With your explicit consent or at your active choice (e.g., a coach viewing authorized student learning data);

With necessary service providers for login, object storage, speech synthesis, push notifications, etc., within the minimum scope required, requiring them to process data for agreed purposes and maintain confidentiality;
As required by laws, regulations, litigation, arbitration, or administrative authorities;
When necessary to protect the vital legitimate interests of you, us, or other parties regarding life, property, or similar rights;
In mergers, acquisitions, asset transfers, or similar transactions involving personal information, we will require successors to remain bound by this policy or obtain your consent again.
legal.privacy.section5.title: 5. Third-Party Services and SDKs
legal.privacy.section5.body: Our services may integrate third-party login, storage, speech, analytics, and other capabilities. Third parties may collect and use related information under their own privacy policies. We recommend reviewing those policies. We integrate third parties only to the extent necessary for functionality and require them to protect your information.
legal.privacy.section6.title: 6. Protection of Minors
legal.privacy.section6.body: If you are a minor, please read this policy and use our services under guardian guidance. We process minors' personal information only where permitted by law, with guardian consent, or as necessary to protect minors. If a guardian believes we collected a minor's information without consent, please contact us through feedback channels and we will verify and address it promptly.
legal.privacy.section7.title: 7. Your Rights
legal.privacy.section7.intro: To the extent permitted by applicable law, you have the following rights:
legal.privacy.section7.items: Access and obtain a copy of your personal information;
Correct or supplement inaccurate or incomplete information (via profile, settings, and similar pages);
Delete specific information or deactivate your account (after deactivation we stop providing services and delete or anonymize related information except where retention is required by law);
Withdraw consent where processing is consent-based (without affecting prior processing based on consent);
Obtain an explanation of our personal information processing rules.
legal.privacy.section7.footer: You may submit these requests through in-app settings, your personal center, or Feedback. After verifying your identity, we will respond within a reasonable period.
legal.privacy.section8.title: 8. Policy Updates
legal.privacy.section8.body: We may revise this policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated through pop-ups, in-app messages, announcements, or other reasonable means. The updated policy takes effect upon publication. Continued use of our services constitutes acknowledgment and acceptance of the updated policy.
legal.privacy.section9.title: 9. Contact Us
legal.privacy.section9.body: If you have questions, complaints, or suggestions about this policy or personal information processing, please contact us through in-app Feedback. When using our services, please also read our <0>Terms of Service</0>.
